description:
Search notes and logs, and summarise thread activity. Results are pointers (an absolute path plus metadata), never file bodies.

Subcommands:
  notes [--thread T] [--type TYPE] [--text S] [--since D] [--until D] [--limit N] [--json] — find notes
  logs [--thread T] [--text S] [--since D] [--until D] [--limit N] [--json] — find daily logs
  activity [--thread T] [--since D] [--until D] [--json] — rank threads by what happened in a window
  overview THREAD [--since D] [--until D] [--limit N] [--json] — the whole picture of one thread
  stream [--thread T] [--kind K] [--text S] [--today] [--reverse] [--since D] [--until D] [--limit N] [--json] — every dated record merged into one chronology, newest first

Flags:
  all subcommands:
    --thread T        'Kind/Name', name or wikilink (for activity, limits to one thread)
    --since YYYY-MM-DD  on or after this date
    --until YYYY-MM-DD  on or before this date
    --json            JSON output
  notes:
    --type TYPE       note type, e.g. Meeting; case-insensitive
    --text S          case-insensitive literal matched in topic and body
    --limit N         default 20; 0 = all
  logs:
    --text S          case-insensitive literal matched in entry lines
    --limit N         default 20; 0 = all
  overview:
    --limit N         recent items to list; default 5; 0 = all
  stream:
    --kind K          comma-separated from note,log,task,done,dropped,hours,payment,thread,person,pending; default all
    --text S          case-insensitive literal matched in thread and summary
    --today           only today (same as --since and --until set to today)
    --reverse         oldest first
    --limit N         default 100; 0 = all

Examples:
  ["notes", "--thread", "Projects/Northwind", "--type", "Meeting", "--json"]
  ["logs", "--text", "invoice", "--since", "2026-09-01"]
  ["overview", "Projects/Northwind", "--json"]
  ["stream", "--today", "--kind", "task,done,hours"]

Notes:
  To read a result, open its path, or pass a note's stem to `notes cat`.
  Dates are event dates (the frontmatter timestamp), not the date the note was written.
  Hours descriptions are not searched; --text covers notes and logs only.
  Exit 1: unknown --kind value.
